explanation: The released code applies masked_fill(-inf) to boolean masks, leaving boolean dtype. PyTorch SDPA treats True as allowed. Thus all-false encoder/cross masks block all attention; upper-triangular decoder masks allow later tokens. This verifies the inspected branch behavior, not the architecture used to train published checkpoints or the validity of the paper.
missing_architecture_configuration: Training parser never declares embedding_dim,nhead,num_encoder_layer,num_decoder_layer,dropout; checked DeepSpeed configs do not define them either.
